answer.explanation: Live configuration shows the Thumbnailer's OUTPUT_BUCKET set to 'missing-bucket-lambda-rca', while the committed SAM template sets it to !Ref OutputBucket (the real output bucket). The function was last modified at 00:21:37Z, two seconds before the window starts. From 00:21:39.958Z onward, the logs show repeated NoSuchBucket errors on PutObject at handler.py line 43, so thumbnails are not being written. The IaC template and the commit history contain no thumbnailer change, so this is out-of-band drift in the live configuration. The recent commits touch only the uploader's OUTPUT_BUCKET and the crud-api's TABLE_NAME, and the live values for those match their intended state, so they are not the cause.
